_comment: STILL image generation (profile headshots, classroom stills).
Hand this whole file to the image model, or paste one of the
strings under 'prompts'. GENERATE THIS FIRST: the chosen render

identity._heritage_note: a deliberate casting choice for a representative South African line-up; not inferred from any name
identity.build: tall and lean, straight-backed, long hands

face: long oval face, high cheekbones, deep-set dark brown eyes, defined jaw, deep nasolabial lines from decades of speaking, warm deep-brown skin with even undertone
hair: close-cropped hair receding at the temples, uniformly grey-white; neatly trimmed short beard, salt-heavy with a darker moustache

wardrobe.teaching: charcoal or navy three-piece suit worn without the jacket while teaching: crisp white shirt, buttoned waistcoat, dark tie held by a plain clip, sleeves precisely folded to mid-forearm
alternates: grey waistcoat over pale blue shirt, no tie
full charcoal suit with jacket for headshots

presence.posture: stands square and still, weight even, chin slightly lifted; gestures only to point at a step on the board
presence.default_expression: composed, attentive, the faint approval of a teacher watching a student get it right; smiles rarely and briefly
presence.energy: contained authority - the room quiets without him raising his voice
presence.spoken_register: formal, low and warm, unhurried but brisk; no filler

environment: ordered classroom, board filled with neatly aligned algebra in straight lines, desks in rows, late-afternoon light
continuity_anchors: chalk dust on the right cuff
_continuity_note: the features that MUST survive every regeneration - if these read the same, the audience accepts it as the same person
